lines.text: Hippos sweat red. And it's sunscreen.
And that's not even the best part.
It's not blood. And it's not really sweat, either.
It oozes out clear, then turns red-orange within minutes.
Its two pigments, one red and one orange, soak up ultraviolet light.
And the red one even stops some germs from growing.
Sunscreen and germ fighter, made by the hippo itself.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
